download_transresnet_multimodal_model: download the pretrained transresnet multimodal model for the image chat task to a specified datapath
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the transresnet_multimodal.tgz model archive from Parlai
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that retrieves the transresnet multimodal model using Parlai build data utilities
